name: Recency-weighted EA + value diversity
tagline: Expected-Attention with exponential-recency weighted query mean/cov, fused with a per-token value-diversity bonus and a recency ramp.

key_hyperparams.name: λ_recency
key_hyperparams.role: exponential decay on query positions for weighted mean/cov

key_hyperparams.name: recent_fraction
key_hyperparams.role: fraction of n_kept reserved as recency ramp

key_hyperparams.name: short_seq_threshold
key_hyperparams.role: below this length, compression is disabled

init_recovers: Expected-Attention baseline at λ_recency=0, β_diversity=0, no recency ramp.
diff_from_baseline: On top of Expected-Attention: replaces the uniform mean/covariance with an exponential-recency-weighted estimator, adds a normalized value-diversity bonus 1-cos(v,neighbors), and overlays a graded recency ramp on the most recent ~25% of kept tokens.

name: GQA-pooled obs-window + cross-layer EMA
tagline: Within an observation window of last 128 queries, GQA-max-pool attention onto KV heads, EMA across layers, then force-keep sinks and a budget-scaled recent window.

key_hyperparams.name: W_obs
key_hyperparams.role: observation-window size for explicit attention probing

key_hyperparams.name: value_norm ε
key_hyperparams.role: added to attn_pool before scaling by ‖v‖

diff_from_baseline: Departs from Expected-Attention by computing exact attention from a 128-token observation window (not future-query Gaussian), then GQA-max-pools across query-head groups and the window so a token critical to any head/query is preserved; adds a layer-bottom-up EMA for cross-layer consistency, plus a layer-0 bypass.

name: Anchor-balanced pooled saliency
tagline: Workload/layer-conditioned sinks+tail, last-token query relevance fused with pool-novelty, value-norm, and a mid-context bridge prior.
diff_from_baseline: A heuristic departure from EA/StreamingLLM: uses only the last-token query (no Gaussian future model), adds chunk-level novelty and a mid-context bridge term, and tunes sinks/tail/pool size by workload metadata so different LongBench tasks get different recency budgets.

name: Expected-Attention + value-norm gate + pos bias
tagline: Expected-Attention scoring multiplied by a min-max value-norm gate, with an explicit edge boost on first 16 / last 32 tokens.
init_recovers: Expected-Attention with value-norm rescaling when the position bonus is zero and the +0.5 offsets do not change the top-k ranking.
diff_from_baseline: On top of Expected-Attention: multiplies (attn+0.5) by a min-max-rescaled (vnorm+0.5) instead of additive (attn+ε)·‖v‖, adds a hand-coded ramp boosting the first 16 and last 32 tokens, and re-rotates selected keys to compact positions.

name: Last-token attention + value-norm
tagline: Treat the last hidden state's query as the future-query proxy; score keys by softmax dot product, scale by value norm, force-keep 4 sinks.
init_recovers: A stripped-down Expected-Attention with no covariance, no future-position averaging, and only the very last query.
diff_from_baseline: Simplifies Expected-Attention down to a single deterministic future query (the last hidden state), drops the covariance correction and the future-position RoPE averaging, but keeps the sink protection and value-norm rescaling, then rerotates kept keys.
